quarterly_data.signal: De-risking AMD's first rack-scale ramp: asked how Helios avoids the growing pains a peer had when it first went to rack scale, Matt Ramsay said AMD has taken customer feedback while setting up the ODM partners and supply chain, and that the ZT Systems acquisition brought system-level talent that has 'proven invaluable to hardening the design and de-risking the different design points'. He described 'a very large Gantt chart' for the ramp and said AMD tried to design the system to take risk out of the design.
